caption: The drawing depicts a semi-circular fabric or textile item with embroidered details. The edge of the item is bordered with a pattern in blue, gold, and brown tones. The central decoration features floral embroidery with prominent pink flowers, green leaves, and smaller blue and yellow accents. Arranged across the middle in an arc are the words “St. George Relief Society” in gold/yellow script, and just below, the year “1899” is stitched in large pink and lavender characters. The background is a soft, pale, cream color resembling cloth, and the stitching lines and texture give the dimensional appearance of embroidery. The overall effect is that of a decorative textile, likely commemorative or ceremonial, presented on an off-white or beige paper background. There is some handwritten text in pencil at the bottom which appears to be notes or names, but it is faint and cursive.
title: Patchwork Quilt - Section
